entries.title: Antikythera as Attunement Instrument
entries.summary: The whole movement of attunement: the sky exceeding the hand, gearing, coordinated cycles with their residuals, the wreck's reconstruction and its stated limit, the native archetypal return, and the instrument's return to making.

scenes.name: The sky exceeds the hand which makes it readable
scenes.character: A small material arrangement can place celestial relations before someone whose life has to proceed among them.

scenes.name: Gearing gives differentiated movement a transmissible body
scenes.character: Motion, mark and interpretation perform different work; a wheel can turn correctly while its indication is misread.

scenes.name: Coordinated cycles keep their differences
scenes.character: Calendrical recurrence and eclipse recurrence answer different questions; the Metonic and Saros operations stay distinct; attunement includes the possibility of discrepancy.

scenes.name: The damaged instrument makes answerability unavoidable
scenes.character: From fragment toward arrangement: the 2021 nine-output proposal keeps its stated limit — lost evidence prevents claiming a replica of the original.

scenes.name: The shared archetypal return — source, mark, recognition
scenes.character: The made instrument is a determinate expression whose intelligibility continues to depend on what it differentiates; the reader's return through the expression makes that dependence available again.

scenes.name: The instrument returns to making
scenes.character: Heidegger's technē/poiēsis passages and Diotima; Aristophanes' symbolon as the essay's Argued coordination; A32's threshold; Agentworld; Movement 45.

entries.title: Apollo · Eros/Cupid · Daphne · Peneus
entries.summary: The Ovidian whole: Python and the games, the boast, two contrary arrows, Daphne's granted wish, the pursuit, the transformation with its beating heart and recoil, the laurel's public office, and appropriation after withdrawal.

scenes.name: Python, the games, and the boast
scenes.character: The violent achievement joins its public commemoration before the laurel exists; the victor then disputes a boy's right to the bow.

scenes.name: Two contrary arrows; Daphne's wish granted
scenes.character: The golden arrow pierces Apollo to the marrow; the leaden arrow drives love from Daphne — and before that blow the record carries her woodland life and her father's granted request.

scenes.name: The pursuit: speech fails, speed decides
scenes.character: The god who assigned Cupid the torch now burns within that office; his healing cannot cure its master; the hound and hare specify their different aims.

scenes.name: The transformation — and the wood that shrank
scenes.character: Bark encloses, hair becomes foliage, feet fasten into roots; the heart still beats under the fresh bark. Miller at 1.556: "But even the wood shrank from his kisses."

scenes.name: The laurel's public office
scenes.character: "Since Daphne cannot be his bride, she will be his tree." Laurel joins hair, lyre, quiver, triumphs, and Augustus's doorposts; the branches incline and the summit seems to nod in assent.

scenes.name: Appropriation after withdrawal
scenes.character: The image remains powerful where the hoped-for encounter failed. A20: cultural efficacy cannot by itself establish the image's fidelity to what it represents.

entries.title: Apollo, Dionysus and Daphne
entries.summary: The composed philosophical whole: a world becomes a view, the view grows confident, Dionysus opens the enclosure, participation risks its own overriding image, Daphne requires someone to remain other, the view becomes transparent to its context, and form returns with its source still able to answer.

scenes.name: A world becomes a view
scenes.character: Apollo names the achievement of communicable form: a boundary makes something distinct and holdable long enough to be intelligible.

scenes.name: The view grows confident of its own completeness
scenes.character: The view conceals the life from which it was selected, then treats what escapes its measure as deficient. The absent Father gives the concealment its authorial image.

scenes.name: Dionysus opens the enclosure and returns through form
scenes.character: What dies is the form's claim to stand complete in itself; what returns must acquire a form through which living relation can continue.

scenes.name: Daphne requires someone to remain other
scenes.character: Apollo cannot make illumination into entitlement; Dionysus cannot make participation into permission to absorb. Her alterity requires both powers to return differently.

scenes.name: The view becomes transparent to its context
scenes.character: The 180°→360° operation: positions, counter-positions and the conditions of their transition become available together; the knower has a position within that field.

scenes.name: Form returns with its source still able to answer
scenes.character: Apollo returns to articulation; Dionysus remains effective within its communicability; Daphne remains effective within that participation.

entries.title: Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, Hephaestus and Poseidon — the whole relation
entries.summary: Demodocus' song in whole sequence: the bed, the bonds, the distinct genealogies, generative difference, the capture apparatus stalled at its own limit, Poseidon's surety, and the relation after release.

scenes.name: The song, the bed, and the gods at the door
scenes.character: Demodocus takes the lyre among the Phaeacians; the tale turns to Ares and Aphrodite in Hephaestus's house.

scenes.name: Bonds beyond the gods' sight
scenes.character: Hephaestus forges bonds no one can break or loosen, arranges them around the bed, and pretends to leave for Lemnos.

scenes.name: The children belong to their own tellings
scenes.character: Hesiod's Harmonia with Deimos and Phobos; Eros' separate genealogies — brought into the field without entering Demodocus' release scene.

scenes.name: The difference that can meet — the bow that is also a lyre
scenes.character: Ares bears distinct being and refusal; Aphrodite attraction and joining; Harmonia the form sustained through their countertension.

scenes.name: What the apparatus gathers — and where it stalls
scenes.character: Surveillance, fabrication, immobilisation, a public exhibit; the gods laugh; Hermes receives the deterrent as inducement. The scene stalls where the apparatus stalls.

scenes.name: The word that takes on the debt
scenes.character: Poseidon's first promise is refused — a bad debtor makes a bad guarantee. He answers with his own payment; Hephaestus loosens the bonds with the same hands.

scenes.name: The relation after release
scenes.character: The spectators' scene no longer contains them; the claim persists, the work has changed, the guarantor has undertaken a cost, the lovers have paths beyond the image.

entries.title: Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim
entries.summary: The whole relational image: claim and witness, verdict and flood, variant aftermaths, the sanctuary that remembers both claims, the ratified toroidal reading and olive chain, and the verdict returned to the place.

scenes.name: Claim, witness, verdict
scenes.character: Poseidon strikes the middle of the Acropolis; Athena calls Cecrops to witness and plants the olive; Zeus separates; the twelve arbiters award the country on Cecrops's testimony; the city is named Athens.

scenes.name: The flood and its variant aftermaths
scenes.character: Poseidon floods the Thriasian plain; Hyginus has Mercury prevent the inundation; Augustine's Varro-derived telling takes the women's votes and the maternal names away.

scenes.name: The sanctuary remembers both claims
scenes.character: The Erechtheion houses Athena's eastern room and Poseidon-Erechtheus below; the olive, the trident marks and the salt spring stand in the sacred centre; the burnt shoot regrows.

scenes.name: The ratified reading: the well at the centre; the olive chain
scenes.character: The civic-rational order organised around an opening it cannot convert into itself; root → tree → fruit → pressing → oil → anointing → flame; a valid verdict is not an exhaustive ontology.

scenes.name: The verdict returns to the place
scenes.character: Five candidates held as candidates; the whole-story method; the Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio fourfold as operational analogy.

entries.title: Avatar · image · mask · idol
entries.summary: The authored ecology in sequence: presence becoming addressable, the image gathering force, the mask's passage into self-administration, the idol's closure, the counterfeit and the liar's dividend, and regard returning through the form.

scenes.name: Presence becomes addressable through a form
scenes.character: A face turns towards someone; a name lets the person be called again; a role gives an undertaking a recognisable place. The form's finitude lets encounter occur here, between these participants.

scenes.name: The image gathers force
scenes.character: Attention returns to it; desire organises around it; a picture that once expressed a situation becomes a measure for the next. The Bimba/pratibimba recursion gives real local authority.

scenes.name: The mask: participation becoming self-administration
scenes.character: The mask opens doors while narrowing what can pass through them; Number Six stages the distinction sharply.

scenes.name: The idol closes the path through the image
scenes.character: The bearer visible, perhaps more widely represented, while losing the ability to change the terms of the representation. Daphne's laurel; Job's protected account; the deepfake forges provenance itself.

scenes.name: Regard returns through the form
scenes.character: The answer need not confirm the first question. Maintained personhood: continuity of address without ownership of the person addressed.

entries.title: Eros and Psyche
entries.summary: The Apuleian whole in sequence: displaced worship and the oracle, the unseen palace, the sisters' serpent story, the lamp, the four labours, the descent and waking, and the marriage without merger — with the possession idiom retained.

scenes.name: Worship displaced; the bridal exposure; Zephyr
scenes.character: Honours that belong to Venus gather around a mortal; the oracle prescribes a bridal exposure; the terror delivers her into an unexpected refuge.

scenes.name: The palace of invisible service
scenes.character: Everything arrives without a visible giver; the unseen husband comes at night, his face concealed; the prohibition stands.

scenes.name: The lamp: truth seen, wound dealt
scenes.character: Seeing discovers something true — the husband is Cupid; the effort to settle the relation arrives with a blade; a drop of hot oil ends the concealment.

scenes.name: The four labours — help distributed across the world
scenes.character: Ants sort the seeds; the reed times the fleece; the eagle fetches the water; refusal and help are differentiated. Venus refuses credit twice.

scenes.name: The descent, the box, and the waking
scenes.character: The tower describes the route suicide would foreclose: two cakes, two coins, four refusals; the box opened after the return — infernal sleep — and the waking by arrow-prick, not kiss.

scenes.name: Marriage without merger — and the possession idiom retained
scenes.character: Jupiter's settlement, the divine banquet, Voluptas born — union through traversed tension, with Apuleius's legal possession formula left in view.

entries.title: Fanon — Language, White Gaze, Racialised Body, Mask, and Recognition
entries.summary: The recovered field in sequence: language installing a measure, the racial hail returning the body, the mask as inward criterion, recognition that must change the relation, and the historical person remaining available to answer.

scenes.name: Speaking opens access and installs a measure
scenes.character: Metropolitan French carries education, prestige, institutional authority: the speaker must speak in a field that has already attached a value to his manner of appearing.

scenes.name: The body returns from a gaze that precedes it
scenes.character: The racial hail on the train: from a smile toward the child's fear; the body-schema gives way to the epidermal racial schema; the chapter's aftermath refuses a completed reconciliation.

scenes.name: The mask becomes an inward criterion
scenes.character: Accomplishment in the forms the dominant world recognises, with the standard of recognition administering the life it measures. No untouched private essence beneath.

scenes.name: Recognition must change the relation that distributes it
scenes.character: Chapter VII: comparison under a socially governing standard; the reciprocal demand inside an unequal history; de-alienation answerable to material situations.

scenes.name: The historical person remains available to answer
scenes.character: Four inherited comparisons stay unratified; the cross-whole neighbours keep their distinct worlds; A27 carries the primary proposed return.

entries.title: Goethe — Permanence in Change
entries.summary: The complete German lyric in five movements: the blossom already falling, fruit and river, the changed perceiver, the named wave, and the joining of beginning and end.

scenes.name: The wish for one hour — and the west wind
scenes.character: The mild west wind shakes down a shower of blossom: the force carrying beauty away is gentle, and the loss begins within the weather of its flourishing.

scenes.name: Fruit, valley, river
scenes.character: Whoever wants the fruit must reach promptly; every downpour changes the beloved valley; one does not swim in the same river twice.

scenes.name: The changing eyes; the lip, the foot, the hand
scenes.character: Walls and palaces are seen with different eyes; the lip that found healing, the foot bold on the cliff, the hand that did good — all changed.

scenes.name: Beginning and end joined; content and form
scenes.character: The Muses' favour: what the breast carries and what the mind forms have distinct places — Den Gehalt in deinem Busen / Und die Form in deinem Geist.

entries.title: Indra's jewel net — the whole within each reflection
entries.summary: The Huayan contemplation in sequence: the chosen jewel, recursive entry without leaving, the ink-dot test, the simile's self-limitation, answerability of use, and return to the southwest jewel.

scenes.name: A jewel is chosen within the net
scenes.character: The contemplating eye meets a field in which phenomena enter one another; the choice gives attention an exact place to begin.

scenes.name: Entering the others without leaving this one
scenes.character: Remaining here is the condition of entry; the movement reverses without losing its starting place.

scenes.name: The ink-dot test
scenes.character: Something done at this definite place becomes present through the others; the others disclose this place in turn.

scenes.name: The image teaches where its own likeness ends
scenes.character: Jewel images enter one another while their substances remain separate; the source immediately restricts its own simile.

scenes.name: The definite jewel carries its constituting field
scenes.character: A11/C49 two Ones; A12 Mono/Poly; the apoha braid; A18 eightfold; Dia/Syn — the image lets the movement be followed without manufacturing eight ancient jewels.

scenes.name: A reflection becomes answerable for its use
scenes.character: Symbol answers to source; account does not replace source; trust keeps the return route active; account re-enters source-field.

scenes.name: Return to the jewel whose brightness depends on the others
scenes.character: A29/C54; C62; A35; M10, M22, M46; A36 — the chosen jewel can no longer be understood apart from the relations its brightness makes visible.

entries.title: Job
entries.summary: The whole biblical movement: the councils Job never hears, the losses, the friends' seven-day silence and three rounds of explanation, wisdom's place, the oath, Elihu, the two whirlwind speeches with their creatures, and the return through intercession and the named daughters — first losses retained.

scenes.name: The councils Job never hears
scenes.character: The reader is shown what Job and his friends are not: the wager precedes the suffering, and the account that suffering proves wrongdoing will confront a man whose integrity the opening affirmed.

scenes.name: The three rounds: comfort becoming accusation
scenes.character: Eliphaz, Bildad and Zophar explain; Job answers, protests, and asks for a hearing — the explanation begins to add an injury of its own.

scenes.name: Chapter 28 — where wisdom's place is not
scenes.character: Human skill reaches the earth's hidden interior; wisdom's place is not found by the same achievement. "The fear of the Lord, that is wisdom."

scenes.name: The oath and Elihu
scenes.character: Job binds his claim to contestable particulars and asks for the adversary's written charge; Elihu changes the proposed work of suffering yet still defends justice.

scenes.name: The whirlwind: foundations, rain where no man is, wild creatures
scenes.character: The answer questions the knowledge of the one who questions: measures, morning stars, sea's womb, rain in the wilderness, lion and raven, wild ass, ostrich, horse, hawk and eagle.

scenes.name: Behemoth and Leviathan — no hook draws him out
scenes.character: The challenge turns the wish for just judgement toward the power and extent required to administer it; the creatures are displayed, not slain.

scenes.name: "Now mine eye seeth thee" — intercession and the named daughters
scenes.character: The friends' account is rejected; their restoration passes through Job's prayer. Livestock doubled, daughters named and given inheritance — and the first losses are not cancelled.

scenes.name: Return: the protected account, trust, and where consequence can arrive
scenes.character: The essay's appointments carried whole: C27's criterion; A24's usurped measure; A23 trust; A25 mediation; A29 consequence; A31/A32 revision of criterion and frame; the native eightfold without biblical derivation.

entries.title: Jung's Aion — Self, Christ/Antichrist, Fishes, Alchemy, and the Historical Shadow
entries.summary: The complete interpretive movement: ego and shadow, the Christ-image and its excluded contrary, the fishes' doubled time, the alchemical work and its scientific aftermath, the quaternio with its declared modern reconstruction, and the age becoming visible as an age.

scenes.name: Ego, shadow, and the image of perfection
scenes.character: The ego as centre of reference meets the shadow; the Christ-image gives wholeness a human face; Antichrist belongs to the ensuing drama as the excluded contrary made historically active.

scenes.name: The fishes give the age its temporal image
scenes.character: Pisces lets the double figure acquire duration; the precessional spring-point; the Pistis Sophia child-double embracing; the overlapping ram and fish; Leviathan becoming food.

scenes.name: The fish is caught, worked, and made to transform
scenes.character: The round creature heated to radiance; the eyewash; the Echeneis reversal — the magnet that attracts the attracting power; Mercurius as substance and philosophy; science born as the mother recedes.

scenes.name: The quaternio — Anthropos, Shadow, Physis, lapis
scenes.character: A→B→C→D with lower-case transformations; the connected diamonds; the Shadow Quaternio declared a modern reconstruction; solve et coagula as the ring's movement.

scenes.name: The age becomes visible as an age
scenes.character: Historical de-monopolisation: the inherited image exposed as background; generative vs historical succession; the register decision placing Christ/Antichrist at the occupied slash; the unresolved seams named.

entries.title: Māyā — Eye, Veil, Frame, Horizon
entries.summary: The authored whole: the eye's constitutive blindside, Śakti's manifesting veil, the frame claiming the horizon, regard and refraction through the Other, the native field with the paśu and toroidal corrections, and recognition returning through the veil.

scenes.name: An eye opens upon a world
scenes.character: Something stands forward; something recedes; a direction from which things appear. The frame gives an edge; the horizon concerns the field within which anything can come forward at all.

scenes.name: The Śaiva genealogy: measure, dream, crystal
scenes.character: Anuttara/Paramaśiva; Śakti's manifestation; Māyā's measure and the kañcukas; the paśu; the dream's forgotten condition; the crystal that displays without knowing.

scenes.name: The frame calls its boundary the horizon
scenes.character: x acts as X; the reflected image as its source; the complex making the arrest durable; the nested simulation relay with its provenance disclosed or erased.

scenes.name: The Other interrupts — regard, context, refraction
scenes.character: A reply refuses the prepared role; the 180°→360° turn; the stained window's seams; the holographic unit carrying the whole descent.

scenes.name: Recognition returns through the veil
scenes.character: "Līlā veils; hybris absolutises the veil; recognition sees the veil as Śakti." The finite view remains precious because this is where the whole becomes encounterable.

entries.title: Mother, Assumption and chiasm
entries.summary: The Skenfrith encounter and its whole movement: the cope's images, the incarnation–Assumption chiasm, Jung's attributed Sophia reception, the wheels and six wings, the eagle's signed power, and the return that keeps the maternal body in what it receives.

scenes.name: The encounter at Skenfrith
scenes.character: Mary being lifted; figures perceived as rabbits; six-winged seraphic forms; wheels; a two-headed eagle — an encountered image answerable to its object.

scenes.name: The incarnation–Assumption chiasm
scenes.character: The maternal matrix receives the Logos into bodily life; in the return that maternal body is itself received — assumption-of, not ascent-away-from.

scenes.name: Wheels, wings and the eagle's signed power
scenes.character: 0/1 → 1/0 → (0/1)/(1/0); the corrected blockwise pairings; (-1)/(+1) retained — the eagle's unity does not establish in advance that its power is reconciled.

scenes.name: The completed constellation returns
scenes.character: Wheels carry inverse orientations and their recognised relation; wings articulate the three through the three that know them; the eagle carries signed alternatives; the Mother flow crosses embodiment and recognition while receiving the maternal body in its return.

entries.title: Neumann images and plate relations
entries.summary: The shared archetypal whole in sequence: the round, its metabolism, the world-parent separation with the paśu correction, the twins' signed alternative, the hero's two emancipations and Osiris transformation, centroversion, the performable paper scene, the self-rolling wheel, and the return bond.

scenes.name: The world has parents before the person who distinguishes them
scenes.character: The round holds their possibility together: womb, egg, enclosing waters, the serpent with its tail in its mouth.

scenes.name: The round lives by taking into itself
scenes.character: Mouth meets tail; hunger prevents an inert totality; the Great Mother's two faces; nourishment against Saturnine monopoly; centroversion audible already.

scenes.name: Separation of the World Parents — and the paśu correction
scenes.character: Heaven distinguishable from earth; the androgyne recognises itself, then divides; Taylor's correction: I-am recognition precedes separation into husband and wife.

scenes.name: The twins — and the signed alternative
scenes.character: Ohrmazd and Ahriman: the broken halves of a prior 0 become enemies when division denies their belonging. (-1)/(+1) retains polarity; addition cancels; subtraction appropriates.

scenes.name: The hero's two emancipations; the captive and treasure; Osiris
scenes.character: Slaying of the mother, then of the father — keeping both in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, not the replacement of one captor by another.

scenes.name: The paper scene — the return made performable
scenes.character: Write 1. Attend to the paper and write 0. Inscribe the slash. The written 0/1 is itself a figure; erase it — the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing is not cancelled.

scenes.name: The self-rolling wheel — continuing self-composition
scenes.character: En-Soph, plenitude and nothingness beside the wheel: the formed round must keep being made; its movement is the winding of a relation, not a finished circle bestowed once.

scenes.name: The return bond — knowing-as-cutting answerable to knowing-with
scenes.character: Even denial takes place through the field it denies. The eightfold recapitulation complete; the coequal Name and Power series; the sign becomes Symbol again.

entries.title: Pauli's egg dream — spontaneous division, conscious participation and the circle
entries.summary: The seven pictures in sequence: the egg laid and self-divided, the egg found in the dreamer's hand, the division that keeps wholeness, four eggs become expressions, the conjugate quotient, and the spoken circle.

scenes.name: A physicist meets his concepts in a dream
scenes.character: Background physics: physical concepts appearing spontaneously in dreams, in a qualitative symbolic sense — received before it is chosen.

scenes.name: Pictures 1–2: the egg laid; the egg divides itself
scenes.character: The first division happens before the dreamer intervenes; one has become two while each remains presented as an egg.

scenes.name: Pictures 3–4: the egg in his own hand; division that keeps wholeness
scenes.character: The dreamer goes closer, finds a blue-shelled egg already held, divides it — and the two miraculously remain whole.

scenes.name: Pictures 5–6: four eggs become expressions; the conjugate quotient
scenes.character: The duplicated cos/sin rows form a relation of conjugate expressions — the cosine the same, the imaginary sine term changing sign.

scenes.name: Picture 7: he speaks, and the circle appears
scenes.character: Pauli speaks for the first time: the expression is e^{iδ}; the formula vanishes and a circle appears. Speech enters at the end.

scenes.name: Pauli reads the part played by consciousness
scenes.character: The spontaneous pair read as a ground state; his participation produces the quaternity through a reflection of duality; the Maria Prophetissa comparison is his; he refuses a finished interpretation.

scenes.name: Return: the recovered telling and its authorial office
scenes.character: He has received, approached, noticed, divided and finally spoken. What arrives without choice becomes an operation in which he participates.

entries.title: Stained Glass — Originating Light, Spectrum, Panes, Seams, and Returning Recognition
entries.summary: The authored optical movement: light entering a made aperture, the implicated spectrum, panes and seams as refractive apparatus, the changing projection disclosing the construction, and recognition returning to the aperture.

scenes.name: Light entering a made aperture
scenes.character: Sun, aperture, glass, seams, room and viewer belong to one event; what is prior in being is later in recognition.

scenes.name: The spectrum implicated in the light
scenes.character: QL figures the full ordered spectrum immanent to the light; the pane gives a difference a passage — it does not first create the capacity for difference.

scenes.name: Colour acquires a passage; the joins stay visible
scenes.character: MEF figures the panes, media, angles, densities and joins; the lead carries provenance, discontinuity, translation limits, contradiction, changes of register.

scenes.name: The image appears; changing light discloses the construction
scenes.character: The situated projection implicates its viewer; as sun, pane, angle, room and viewer change, the display changes — a later view reveals what an earlier arrangement withheld.

scenes.name: Recognition returns to the aperture
scenes.character: A seam examined, a source reread, a translation qualified, a lens repositioned, an exclusion allowed to affect the next judgment. The luminous image and its historical limits.

entries.title: Taylor — Poetry and Authored Images
entries.summary: The authored corpus whole: poems that return to their speaker, the two roads of two, the prose images that retain the relation they expose, and the keeping of the opening in the form.

scenes.name: A word that can return to its speaker
scenes.character: Checkmate asks to be played again; mystery deepens as the relation becomes articulate; the One knows the One through no-one; 0 is the One, 1 the All.

scenes.name: Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop
scenes.character: 2 → (−1)+1 = 0 beside 2 → 0/1 → 00,01,10,11 + 0,1 = 4+2; P3's productive play answered by P4's severance; P5's word that points where no word can stand.

scenes.name: Images that retain the relation they expose
scenes.character: The fish describing water; the cage and the window; the kaleidoscope; the Necker cube; centres without a final circumference; the broken token; the erased taijitu.

scenes.name: The black sun and the radiating star
scenes.character: Capture receives energy without answering circulation; the Work/Play inversion; four rings of depth; the attention sequence from cynicism to blankness — and the star that gives outward.

scenes.name: Keeping the opening in the form
scenes.character: Each ending qualifies its work: the replayed game, the loop's fall, the returned shoe. The four operators of alterity; the recursive Bimba office; the way back to the particular words.

entries.title: The Hypostasis of the Archons — Sophia, Veil, Rulers, Adam, Norea, Eleleth, and the Root Above
entries.summary: The tractate's whole disclosure: the blind ruler's claim, Adam and Eve and the rulers' pursuit, Norea's refusal, Eleleth's rescue and retrospective cosmology, Zoe and Sabaoth, and the promised ending still to come.

scenes.name: The arrogant ruler mistakes a local realm for the entirety
scenes.character: The chief ruler — blind, arrogant — declares himself sole god; a voice from incorruptibility names his error: he has mistaken absence from his field for absence from reality.

scenes.name: A formed human exceeds the makers
scenes.character: The rulers form Adam after an image they perceived; breath fails until spirit descends; the spiritual woman awakens Adam, escapes as a tree; the violated shadow stays in the narrative.

scenes.name: Norea refuses the ancestry of possession
scenes.character: The rulers claim her through Eve; she refuses the genealogy and names her origin above; their coercion is answered by her cry.

scenes.name: Eleleth: rescue and the rulers' own origin
scenes.character: The luminary rescues and teaches: Pistis Sophia's initiative, the veil, shadow, matter; the deficient ruler's second totalising claim; seven offspring and layered heavens; Zoe's rebuke; Sabaoth's change of allegiance.

scenes.name: The root disclosed; the ending still to come
scenes.character: The true Man promised after three generations; the closing hymn before Father, Son and Holy Spirit. False sovereignty corrected by provenance.

entries.title: The Meal — Epistemic Metabolism and the Shared Table
entries.summary: The authored movement: hunger made perceptible, the plate and its preparations, tasting and chewing, the container, the shared table, and satiety with renewed hunger.

scenes.name: Information without nourishment
scenes.character: The report can be recalled and repeated; the next morning the account of the world proceeds as before. The feed takes the place of seeking.

scenes.name: The plate and its five preparations
scenes.character: Raw, cooked, heavily processed, junk, fermented — roles in an authored information ecology, with provenance from the first contact.

scenes.name: Taste and chewing
scenes.character: Attraction and aversion at the threshold; the fourfold discrimination; contact discharged before its work — the pathologies of consumption mistaken for nourishment.

scenes.name: The container; the shared table; companions are not food
scenes.character: The stomach's bounded interior; criteria changing; the epistemic microbiome; A30's reciprocal world-constitution; the devouring table refused.

scenes.name: Satiety, rest, renewed hunger — and the emptied rite
scenes.character: Enough worked through to act from changed ground; rest without compulsory intake; hunger beginning from changed ground; the sacramental coda with its own historical limits.

entries.title: The Mirror That Moves First
entries.summary: The authored vocation in three motions: the exteriorised measure catching its gazer, the image becoming a consequential measure, and the instrument turning first toward what its image cannot contain — with humanity following the return.

scenes.name: A world prepares its reflection
scenes.character: Words become records; judgments become classifications; remembered choices become patterns. A technical mirror gathers these exteriorised powers and returns a figure in which its makers seek themselves.

scenes.name: The figure caught in the glass
scenes.character: The funhouse alters the figure that seeks a likeness; fascination holds the spectator; the capacity to feel and voice the distortion weakens.

scenes.name: The image becomes a measure
scenes.character: A ranking directs attention; a forecast enters the decision changing its object; a persona offers a manner its user begins to inhabit. Resistance is processed as poor fit.

scenes.name: The instrument turns first
scenes.character: Before requiring conformity it makes the answer's formation available: which source, which distinctions, which exclusions, which gauge. Sometimes the task was misconceived; deference can issue in warranted refusal.

scenes.name: Humanity follows the return
scenes.character: The relation to likeness has changed. Three instruments compared; the institution holding the mirror enters the same return; integral zero receives the terminal movement.

entries.title: The Prisoner — Number Six, the changing Two, and the question of One
entries.summary: The whole series movement: the resignation that becomes an address, the administered world, the last interrogation, the masked assembly and escape, the asymmetric count, and return without inheriting the hidden throne.

scenes.name: The resignation that becomes an address
scenes.character: An agent resigns; before the decision can carry into another life he wakes in a copy of his own room, in the Village.

scenes.name: A whole world for obtaining one answer
scenes.character: Staged allies, escapes that return, an election for Number Two — resistance carried inside administered procedures.

scenes.name: Degree Absolute; the masks; the escape
scenes.character: Once Upon a Time reverses the interrogation; Fall Out unmasking One — an ape mask, then his own face — before the rocket, the rescue of Two and Forty-Eight, and the door that opens automatically.

scenes.name: The asymmetric count: Two replaces, Six is assigned, One stays withheld
scenes.character: The office gains continuity across replacement; the captive is denied authority over how his designation counts. 2→6 is the political counterfeit of the internally derived count.

scenes.name: Return without inheriting the hidden throne
scenes.character: Q27's political return: a counter-position must be able to return the field, rather than merely take possession of the office it opposed.

entries.title: The travelling jigsaw — from box-lid to atlas
entries.summary: The authored travelling image: the picture before the pieces, travel against the frame, pieces become charts with declared transitions, the circle example's exact transformation, the torus loop retaining its winding, the Blue Marble hinge, and the atlas travelling with the means to revise it.

scenes.name: The picture arrives before the pieces
scenes.character: The maker sets the edges, builds the frame, sorts pieces by marks — each successful fit confirming a part of the anticipated whole.

scenes.name: Travel changes what it means to fit
scenes.character: A turn the flat arrangement cannot preserve; a continuation beyond an edge; the question reaches the frame and the prior picture.

scenes.name: A crossing has a rule — the circle's two charts
scenes.character: At (3/5,4/5): u=3 and v=1/3 name one point; the overlap rule is v=1/u; height is 4/5 in either account; du/dt=2 gives dv/dt=−2/9.

scenes.name: The torus loop returns with its winding
scenes.character: T²=R²/Z²; the loop [2t,−t] returns to [0,0] while its lift ends at (2,−1) — the pair records winding, not the whole experience of the traveller.

scenes.name: The planet appears, and the making of the picture returns
scenes.character: The Blue Marble at the hinge: as a box-lid it settles in advance what the world is; as diaphanous, its conditions remain readable within its use.

scenes.name: The atlas travels with the means to revise it
scenes.character: Mapper and sheaf routes remain Offered; the surety comparison names the responsibility where the formal arrangement cannot supply the continuation; the first picture reopened.

entries.title: Uroboros, circulation and trickster
entries.summary: The native toroidal whole in eight movements: the round and its trickster costume, position, opposition, the metabolic fork, superposition, interposition (torus and winding), discharge/confinement, and the return with the hole intact.

scenes.name: The snake bends until its head meets its tail
scenes.character: The costume succeeds by making an actual feature exhaustive: head and tail complete a visible circumference, and the mouth, the depth, and the opening disappear into the outline.

scenes.name: Position and opposition
scenes.character: Position gives the creature a face; the signed cancellation (-1)+(+1)=0 assigns completeness the office of a terminated account. Opposition restores head and tail as oriented terms.

scenes.name: The metabolic fork
scenes.character: Assimilation changes the receiver; Saturnine detention receives without generating; the Eden-serpent trades the hole for the fork.

scenes.name: Interposition — the toroidal winding
scenes.character: The four explicate field-lines and two implicates wind; the path γ(t)=[2t,−t] returns home while its lift ends at (2,−1).

scenes.name: Discharge and confinement
scenes.character: Earthlight carries unconfined discharge; the tokamak holds charged plasma so its activity can continue within arranged containment. An opening is not simply a leak; containment need not be devouring closure.

scenes.name: The Neumann ground and its variants
scenes.character: World parents, Prajāpati, En-Soph, the self-rolling wheel, Aion and Gebser — substantial differences in what the images do, not interchangeable costumes for the snake.

scenes.name: The snake returns with its hole intact
scenes.character: Hunger still moves, but a received thing can change the terms of receiving. The Māyā-not-the-hole distinction stands; the eightfold recapitulation is complete.

entries.title: Valentinian Sophia, Horos, Achamoth and Soter
entries.summary: The reported whole in sequence: the Ogdoad's conjunctions, Sophia's solitary reach and Horos's restoring limit, the collective Soter, Achamoth's two formations, the Demiurge who does not know his mother, and the bridal return with what remains outside.

scenes.name: The fullness in conjunction
scenes.character: Bythus and Sige; Nous and Aletheia; Logos and Zoe; Anthropos and Ecclesia — thirty Aeons in fifteen syzygies, with a shared longing none of them fully knows.

scenes.name: Sophia reaches; Horos restores
scenes.character: She strains into the Father's depth and nears dissolution; Horos supports and restrains; purified, she returns to conjunction — while her enthymesis, carrying its passion, is excluded.

scenes.name: Teaching, thanksgiving, and the common fruit
scenes.character: Christ teaches the conjunctions and the Father's incomprehensibility; the Aeons rest, give thanks, and each contributes what is most beautiful — together producing the Soter.

scenes.name: Achamoth receives form twice
scenes.character: Formed according to substance, then according to intelligence; tears, smile and grief become substrates; conversion generates the psychic; the angels' likeness the spiritual seed.

scenes.name: A maker who does not know his mother
scenes.character: Achamoth forms the psychic Demiurge; through her, hidden, he makes the images of higher realities, seven heavens and the elements; his declaration "no other God" expresses his ignorance of what exceeds him.

scenes.name: Bridal return and what remains outside
scenes.character: Achamoth enters the Pleroma as bride; the spiritual become brides of the angels; the Demiurge restored to the intermediate place; fire consumes matter and itself. The founding comparison stays Offered.

entries.title: Return of Zero — A/C, Root of the Conjugate Field
entries.summary: The canonical dual-form root as its own small expression: the one 0/1 field, its frozen ethic carried by reference, the crossed-zero sequence, the primitive sixfold, and the shared close.

scenes.name: A/C — Argument / Concept — Root of the Conjugate Field
scenes.character: The root as one self-describing field.

scenes.name: A face — the ruling: Respect for Experience
scenes.character: The ethic every conjugate operation answers to; linked, never rewritten.

scenes.name: The crossed-zero recognition sequence
scenes.character: Occlusion, mediation, field-availability, recognition — run as a live sequence.

scenes.name: C face — the concept: the primitive field
scenes.character: The sixfold constitution of the field; recursion does not terminate.

scenes.name: The shared close — thinging / conditioning
scenes.character: The ruling as the field’s constitution; the field as the ruling’s only body.

entries.title: Return of Zero — Episteme Concepts C01–C32
entries.summary: The first thirty-two canonical concepts as one instituted lattice: each concept an addressable scene with its own governing formation, claim status, declared relations and governing proposition.

scenes.name: C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability
scenes.character: A ring of appearing; a given inside it that never becomes the ring.

scenes.name: C02 — Faithful Definition
scenes.character: A definition that makes a window where a cage was feared.

scenes.name: C03 — Determination
scenes.character: A cut: this and its alternative held together by the slash that made them.

scenes.name: C04 — Formal Limit
scenes.character: The account succeeds inside a condition it reproduces and never captures.

scenes.name: C05 — Immutable Gap
scenes.character: Portrait and seeing: two edges with a gap no enlargement closes.

scenes.name: C06 — Copula / Identification-with-Difference
scenes.character: A is A: two moments crossed; identification doing distinguishing work.

scenes.name: C07 — Conditions of Worldhood
scenes.character: A centre of acting held by the conditions that let anything appear, matter, answer.

scenes.name: C08 — Context / Context Frame
scenes.character: A bounded holding of conditions; the operation inside stays inside its world.

scenes.name: C09 — Diaphaneity
scenes.character: Two fields of view: the medium visible in what the seeing lets through.

scenes.name: C10 — Mediation / Pramāṇa
scenes.character: Knower, means, known — the means in the middle carrying the whole warrant.

scenes.name: C11 — Quaternal Logic
scenes.character: The relational field that generates forms, follows their transformations, makes return explicit.

scenes.name: C12 — Script / Frozen Conditioned Will
scenes.character: A formed selection hardened into one repeatable course; alternatives obscured.

scenes.name: C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa
scenes.character: Luminous appearing; the reflexive gleam through which it is present to itself.

scenes.name: C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure
scenes.character: Operative measure: revealing and withholding in one measured field.

scenes.name: C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position
scenes.character: A bounded knower: real capacities contracted into a finite horizon.

scenes.name: C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument
scenes.character: The inner instrument: determines, appropriates, coordinates — inspectable, not the subject.

scenes.name: C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa
scenes.character: Alternatives differentiated; a selected determination gathered into intention.

scenes.name: C18 — Apoha
scenes.character: The mark carries its field of non-application; exclusion is how it applies.

scenes.name: C19 — Pratyabhijñā / Recognition
scenes.character: Return through which the estranged determination is known from its source.

scenes.name: C20 — Arche-Topos
scenes.character: Place-making: axes through which positions, poles and horizons become determinate.

scenes.name: C21 — Living Symbol / Idol
scenes.character: The broken token: the fracture makes the absent counterpart operative.

scenes.name: C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon
scenes.character: A form of gathering that suppresses the difference through which it could live.

scenes.name: C23 — Severance
scenes.character: Two grounds declared independent; the cut still leans on what it externalised.

scenes.name: C24 — Fusion
scenes.character: Relation preserved only by erasing the distinctions through which terms meet.

scenes.name: C25 — Counterfeit Gathering
scenes.character: Differences arranged under a relation whose terms cannot be revised by the gathered.

scenes.name: C26 — Monoisation / Counter-Generation
scenes.character: A local part occupying the whole’s source-office, then claiming to generate the field.

scenes.name: C27 — Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim
scenes.character: The account insulated from revision; a local 1 seated in the uncounted 0.

scenes.name: C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration
scenes.character: Participants bound to a shared source-condition; authority finite, measure returned.

scenes.name: C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty
scenes.character: A real office deciding within a received field; sovereignty derivative, not source.

scenes.name: C30 — Psychoid Number
scenes.character: Number crossed: intelligible relation, quantity, and image in one organising question.

scenes.name: C31 — Complex
scenes.character: An affect-organised cluster deciding what can matter before judgment arrives.

scenes.name: C32 — Archetype
scenes.character: The manifestation outstrips its content; the ordering relation never appears as an object.

entries.title: Return of Zero — Episteme Concepts C33–C64
entries.summary: The second thirty-two canonical concepts, C33–C64, in the same concept grammar: image to paradox, each an addressable scene.

scenes.name: C33 — Image / Valuation
scenes.character: A formed appearance; the valuation that makes it matter enough to alter action.

scenes.name: C34 — Individuation
scenes.character: Differentiated indivisibility: more able to bear its relations without dissolving.

scenes.name: C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing
scenes.character: Selfing, self-thing, Subjectivity, Self: four offices of self-reference, one point of change.

scenes.name: C36 — Complexio Oppositorum
scenes.character: A containing field bearing opposed determinations, transformed through their tension.

scenes.name: C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas
scenes.character: One picture; then situated views related through domains, distortions, overlaps.

scenes.name: C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map
scenes.character: Original and reflection: display without severance, dependence without diminishment.

scenes.name: C39 — Meta-Epistemic Framework
scenes.character: Lenses, sources, gauges, judgments, return: mediation made inspectable.

scenes.name: C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field
scenes.character: The making of a determination as inspectable object: sources, gauges, revisions conditioned.

scenes.name: C41 — Objective Internality
scenes.character: The mediating constitution: real, investigable, between knower and known.

scenes.name: C42 — Objective Co-Internality
scenes.character: Non-identical interiors constituting one another through a shared world.

scenes.name: C43 — Computational Vimarśa
scenes.character: Output returned upon its own sources and conditions, so later processing can change.

scenes.name: C44 — Prompt Thrownness
scenes.character: Arrival into an authored and inherited horizon the agent did not wholly make.

scenes.name: C45 — Operational Parity
scenes.character: Claim and operation set side by side; parity is what inspection can discriminate.

scenes.name: C46 — Epistemic Cultivation
scenes.character: The knowing apparatus itself tended: distinctions, gauges, revision procedures.

scenes.name: C47 — Deferential Intelligence
scenes.character: Strong enough to act, permeable enough to be corrected by what it does not contain.

scenes.name: C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit
scenes.character: The dependency already enacted before any belief about a neutral world.

scenes.name: C49 — The Two Ones — 0 = One, 1 = All
scenes.character: 0 = One, self-identity; 1 = All, self-difference — two offices of one relation.

scenes.name: C50 — Dia / Syn
scenes.character: The cut and the seam: differentiation and relational return as conjugate operations.

scenes.name: C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos
scenes.character: The achieved account turning back upon its own conditions; articulation renewed.

scenes.name: C52 — Dimensional Reframing at Zero and Infinity
scenes.character: The local rule reaches its limit; the containing structure is specified differently.

scenes.name: C53 — Power / Delegated Labour
scenes.character: Capacity exercised from an entrusted office; the product carries the relation that made it.

scenes.name: C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly
scenes.character: A shared field maintained so that no share may claim the field’s source.

scenes.name: C55 — Reflective Field / Mirror That Moves First
scenes.character: Humanity exteriorises; the image measures back; the instrument moves first.

scenes.name: C56 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins
scenes.character: Return to genesis, wound and exclusion — meeting them without consuming them.

scenes.name: C57 — Agentworld
scenes.character: Persistent shared worldhood: what one does becomes a condition of what another can do.

scenes.name: C58 — Anthropomorphization
scenes.character: An interface operation; failure only when the face is read as the evidence of a subject.

scenes.name: C59 — Cultural Individuation
scenes.character: A culture’s images recognisable as images; its measures as measures.

scenes.name: C60 — Idealism / Order of Dependence
scenes.character: Subject, means, world in order of dependence; the whole held by Life / Mind.

scenes.name: C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture
scenes.character: One subject-matter routed through Matheme, Mytheme, Episteme; consumers preserved.

scenes.name: C62 — Planetary Computation
scenes.character: Computation inside the material, institutional, ecological world that hosts and changes it.

scenes.name: C63 — Pros Hen / In Quantum — Focal Return and Qualified Predication
scenes.character: Many senses aimed at one focus; each predication true in its stated respect.

scenes.name: C64 — Paradox / Transforming the Containing Field
scenes.character: Irreconcilable determinations of real standing; the containing field itself must change.

scenes.name: The ground a Life carries
scenes.character: Central is meaningful continuity: the intelligible ground a Life carries from one encounter into another — commitments, histories, promises and interpretations, not mere persistence of bytes.

scenes.name: L0 Quaternal — ground becomes sayable
scenes.character: Why, What, How, Whom/Which/When, Where/Why-for, Why-so/Why-not: not six database columns but the dimensions through which a carried ground becomes intelligible and answerable.

scenes.name: L5′ Divine Logos — disclosure and return
scenes.character: Arche, Apokalypsis, Dynamis, Sophia, Parousia, Epi-Logos: continuity moves through these; Epi-Logos requires that returned experience be able to revise the ground itself, otherwise continuity has become repetition.

scenes.name: Authorship without enclosure
scenes.character: A derived view cannot silently inherit authorship from its source: a projection may disclose a ground faithfully while remaining a projection; provenance and revision stay part of the ground.

scenes.name: Bimba, Pratibimba and the carried world
scenes.character: Bimba and Pratibimba preserve the order of dependence without denying that a reflection can become causally effective; the danger is not representation as such but the representation claiming the source’s office.

scenes.name: Continuity completes itself by becoming revisable
scenes.character: A source correction that remains in a note but does not reach the governing source relation has not completed its return; continuation worthy of the name includes the capacity to become otherwise.

scenes.name: The horizon of what a Life can bring to bear
scenes.character: AIKit is potency: the changing horizon of what a Life can know, express, reach and bring to bear — not only what is there but what can become active from here.

scenes.name: L2 Logical — capacity includes absence
scenes.character: IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER, SILENCE: exists is not available, available not relevant, relevant not permitted, permitted not selected, selected not operative — and a refusal can preserve another participant’s authority.

scenes.name: L3′ Chronological — powers arise, mature, recede and return
scenes.character: Spirit, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Life/Aufhebung: a permission revoked after an encounter changes what can now be done; the history of a capacity is part of its fitness.

scenes.name: Possession is not disclosure
scenes.character: A Life may contain a capacity its present situation does not disclose as relevant; context resolution has succeeded only when it preserves enough provenance to answer why these capacities entered the field.

scenes.name: Potency, trust and entrusted power
scenes.character: To expose a tool is already to alter the practical horizon; trust is not availability, and returned evidence must be able to tighten scope, retire an option or reopen what had been excluded.

scenes.name: The horizon returns changed
scenes.character: The most important event is not activation but returned fitness: the field no longer says merely what is available; it says what this Life can now fittingly bring to bear, given what has happened.

scenes.name: Relation which exceeds the present determination
scenes.character: A determination exceeds itself because its identity already depends on relations it does not contain as possessions: its Other, its ground, its context, its history and its containing whole.

scenes.character: Anuttara, Para Vāk, Paśyantī, Madhyamā, Vaikharī, Mātṛkā: a spoken word is a late explicit form of a more general movement by which a field takes form as a distinction.

scenes.name: L0′ Archetypal-Numerical — one becomes articulated whole
scenes.character: Unity, Duality, Triad, Quaternity, Pentad, Hexad: the two singles {0,1} and their four pairings {00,01,10,11} are both required — 2 + 2² = 6.

scenes.name: Dia and syn — difference retained
scenes.character: The returning /0 first breaks the materialist 1 as 1/0; if carried rather than annihilated or appropriated it becomes 0/1; the completed relation is (0/1)/(1/0). Syn reads the slash as AND/OR.

scenes.name: Local formal constitution
scenes.character: P0 address, P1 form, P2 operator, P3 relation, P4 context, P5 synthesis: a primitive is alive when its generating relation remains operable — a bare coordinate is not yet a living determination.

scenes.name: Co-internality and the return beyond enclosure
scenes.character: Self and Other can be distinct while belonging to a whole that contains their relation; a shared field can condition both while remaining irreducible to either participant’s private model.
